title.hr: PAM: kontrolne oznake odlučuju o prijavi
title.en: PAM: control flags decide a login

concept.hr: required, requisite, sufficient i optional zajedno odlučuju o prijavi
concept.en: required, requisite, sufficient and optional together decide a login

summary.hr: Presloži stog auth, prisili module da padnu i prati prijavu redak po redak: ne odlučuje prvi pogodak, oznake se slažu.
summary.en: Reorder the auth stack, make modules fail and step a login line by line: not first match, the flags add up.

title.hr: required pa sufficient: uspjeh se zanemaruje
title.en: required, then sufficient: the success is ignored

concept.hr: Nakon pada required modula uspjeh sufficient modula se zanemaruje
concept.en: After a required module fails, a sufficient success is ignored

title.en: pam_permit on top: everyone gets in

concept.hr: Redoslijed je važan: sufficient pam_permit prvi pušta bilo koju lozinku
concept.en: Order matters: sufficient pam_permit first lets any password in
